newsitem.title: USA: Hearing set on Con Edison restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Hearing set on Con Edison restructuring.

text.p: There New York State Assembly committees said Wednesday they will hold a hearing Friday on the settlement Consolidated Edison Co of New York Inc reached with the staff of the Department of Public Service on implementation of competition.

The standing committees on Energy; Corporation, Authorities, and Commissions; and consumer Affaiors and Protection said the hearing will begin at 1100 EST/1600 GMT Friday in the second floor Public Hedaring Chamber of New York City's City Hall.
Meanwhile, Senator Guy J. Velella said he is in agreement with the New York State Consumer Protection Board's assessment of the Con Edison settlement.

In a letter to John O'Mara, chairman of the New York State Public Service Commission, the senator -- a Republican- Conservative representing the Bronx and Westchester -- expressed his dissatisfaction with the settlement.
Stating his concern that the allocation of savings is not optimal, Velella stressed his opinion that Con Edison has the resources to provide further rate reductions for its residential customers.
